_comment: The 20 messages the LLM judge scores (x3 systems = 60 calls, the free-tier daily ceiling). Pinned rather than redrawn. These ids were drawn with np.random.default_rng(20260909) over the 40-item golden set of round 1; those 40 were themselves drawn uniformly at random from all 198 candidates (scripts/prelabel.py, frozen seed), so these 20 remain a uniform random subsample of the full golden set. Redrawing them when the set grew 40->198 would have invalidated all 60 cached judge calls (0/20 overlap) and bought no additional validity.
